# hestiacp_database (Resource)

Manages a HestiaCP database and database user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `db_name` (String) Database name (without user prefix).
- `db_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `db_user` (String) Database username (without user prefix).

### Optional

- `db_type` (String) Database type: `mysql` or `pgsql`. Defaults to `mysql`.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this database. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
